faqs.q: Where and how are the Enerpac Caterroller load skates, turntables and leveling plates used?
faqs.a: Enerpac Caterroller load skates move heavy machinery on rollers, and the range includes turntables and leveling plates. The listing has 17 models from 1 to 80 ton, such as the ER10 10 ton and the ER60 60 ton skates. This listing carries 17 part numbers.

faqs.q: What sizes and part numbers are listed for the Enerpac Caterroller load skates, turntables and leveling plates?
faqs.a: The listing carries 17 part numbers from 1 to 80 ton in 1, 10, 15, 30, 60 and 80 ton sizes, such as ER1, ER10, ER15, ER30 and ER60 heavy duty Caterroller load skates, with turntables and leveling plates.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right size or model of the Enerpac Caterroller load skates, turntables and leveling plates?
faqs.a: Choose the capacity per skate from 1 to 80 ton, then use enough skates that the load is shared evenly. Add a turntable where the load must be steered and leveling plates on uneven floors.

faqs.q: What working pressure applies to the Enerpac Caterroller load skates, turntables and leveling plates?
faqs.a: The size table gives a capacity in tons for each skate, from 1 to 80 ton, and the capacity is per skate. Use enough skates that no skate carries more than its stated capacity, and keep the floor flat and clean.

faqs.q: What are the Enerpac Caterroller load skates, turntables and leveling plates made from?
faqs.a: The listing does not state the body material of the Enerpac Caterroller load skates, turntables and leveling plates. Jacks are made of steel or, in some ranges, aluminium, so ask us for the maker's data on the model you want if weight or corrosion matters.

faqs.q: Which standards apply to the Enerpac Caterroller load skates, turntables and leveling plates?
faqs.a: The listing names no standard for the Enerpac Caterroller load skates, turntables and leveling plates, and ASME B30.1 is the US safety standard for jacks and jack systems. No certificates are held on the listing, so ask in the enquiry if you need a test certificate or a conformity document.

faqs.q: Which parts do the Enerpac Caterroller load skates, turntables and leveling plates mate with?
faqs.a: The Enerpac Caterroller load skates, turntables and leveling plates need a hydraulic pump or built-in pump, and a firm, level base plate under the jack and a solid contact on the load. Check closed height and stroke against the gap you are lifting, and use cribbing or blocking once the load is raised.

faqs.q: How should the Enerpac Caterroller load skates, turntables and leveling plates be installed and maintained?
faqs.a: Never work under a load held only by a hydraulic jack: crib or block it. Place the Enerpac Caterroller load skates, turntables and leveling plates on a firm, level base, keep the load centred on the saddle and lift in steps, and check for leaks and seal wear before each use.

faqs.q: Which industries and jobs use the Enerpac Caterroller load skates, turntables and leveling plates?
faqs.a: The Enerpac Caterroller load skates, turntables and leveling plates are used for lifting and positioning loads in maintenance, machinery installation and vehicle and plant work, where a hydraulic jack gives more force in less space than a mechanical jack.

faqs.q: How do the Enerpac Caterroller load skates, turntables and leveling plates differ from the Enerpac JH aluminium and steel jacks?
faqs.a: The Caterroller skates move a load sideways on rollers, with capacities of 1 to 80 ton per skate, while [the Enerpac JH aluminium and steel jacks](/p/enerpac-jh-aluminium-and-steel-jacks) lift it vertically in 7 to 100 ton. Use skates to move and jacks to lift.

faqs.a: We ship the Enerpac Caterroller load skates, turntables and leveling plates from our Dubai, UAE warehouse to buyers in the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond. The country of origin depends on the plant that made the batch and is stated on the commercial invoice. Export documents come with the order; ask on [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: Which sizes are the Enerpac SOH hydraulic machine lifts available in?
faqs.a: The listing carries 2 part numbers: SOH106, the SOH-10-6 machine lift of 8.5 ton with a 5.39 in stroke, and SOH236, the SOH-23-6 of 20 ton with a 6.18 in stroke.

faqs.q: How should I select the Enerpac SOH hydraulic machine lifts for my application?
faqs.a: Choose the SOH106 for the 8.5 ton lift or the SOH236 for 20 ton, and check the stroke against the lift height you need. Crib or block the machine once raised.

faqs.q: What pressure rating do the Enerpac SOH hydraulic machine lifts have?
faqs.a: The maker states a capacity in tons for each model of the Enerpac SOH hydraulic machine lifts, and the size table gives it for every part number. Choose a jack on capacity, closed height and stroke, and keep the load inside the rated capacity at the extension you use.

faqs.q: What are the Enerpac SOH hydraulic machine lifts made from?
faqs.a: The listing does not state the body material of the Enerpac SOH hydraulic machine lifts. Jacks are made of steel or, in some ranges, aluminium, so ask us for the maker's data on the model you want if weight or corrosion matters.

faqs.q: Which standards and documents apply to the Enerpac SOH hydraulic machine lifts?
faqs.a: The listing names no standard for the Enerpac SOH hydraulic machine lifts, and ASME B30.1 is the US safety standard for jacks and jack systems. No certificates are held on the listing, so ask in the enquiry if you need a test certificate or a conformity document.

faqs.q: Which parts do the Enerpac SOH hydraulic machine lifts mate with?
faqs.a: The Enerpac SOH hydraulic machine lifts need a hydraulic pump or built-in pump, and a firm, level base plate under the jack and a solid contact on the load. Check closed height and stroke against the gap you are lifting, and use cribbing or blocking once the load is raised.

faqs.q: How should the Enerpac SOH hydraulic machine lifts be installed and maintained?
faqs.a: Never work under a load held only by a hydraulic jack: crib or block it. Place the Enerpac SOH hydraulic machine lifts on a firm, level base, keep the load centred on the saddle and lift in steps, and check for leaks and seal wear before each use.

faqs.q: Which industries and jobs use the Enerpac SOH hydraulic machine lifts?
faqs.a: The Enerpac SOH hydraulic machine lifts are used for lifting and positioning loads in maintenance, machinery installation and vehicle and plant work, where a hydraulic jack gives more force in less space than a mechanical jack.

faqs.q: How do the Enerpac SOH hydraulic machine lifts differ from the Enerpac LW vertical lifting wedges?
faqs.a: The SOH machine lifts raise 8.5 and 20 ton with strokes of 5.39 and 6.18 in, while [the Enerpac LW vertical lifting wedges](/p/enerpac-lw-vertical-lifting-wedges) lift 16 ton by 0.83 in. Choose the SOH lift where you need a longer stroke.
